text: Milk is standardised, heated to make it stable, boiled down under vacuum to about twice its solids, homogenised and given a phosphate stabiliser. It is then filled into cans and sterilised in them, or sterilised by UHT and packed aseptically.

steps.note: To double-concentrated milk: about 7.5 % fat, 17.5 % solids-not-fat, 25 % total solids.
In a multistage falling-film evaporator, to about twice the solids.
In-can lines use two stages at 12.5–25 MPa.
Dose set by sterilisation trials on samples.
